purpose: Freeze the current Dharma Connection source-supply result after dynamically excluding every thread shared with another author in the intended Joel/Stian/David/Greg benchmark, and prevent an impossible fully nonoverlap design from consuming more acquisition work.

Joel Rosenblum.key_finding: After excluding every current thread shared with Stian, David, or Greg, only one 13-word explicit Joel source remains. A fully nonoverlap same-platform four-author Joel benchmark cannot be built from the current explicit-speaker Dharma archive.

Stian Gudmundsen Høiland.reason_automated_gate_failed: Only four profile sources remained versus the predeclared six-source acquisition preference; multiple sources also carry dialogue or ambiguous-speaker quality flags requiring conservative selection.

design_decision.reason: Joel lacks enough nonoverlap Dharma material after excluding the other three benchmark authors. Further blind archive acquisition cannot fix this source-supply fact without changing provenance or overlap rules.
design_decision.matched_dharma_stratum: Use Joel's already frozen shared-thread Dharma originals as the target holdouts while control-author profiles come from independent nonoverlap threads. Report this as a deliberately hard same-platform/topic stratum rather than pretending the target holdouts are nonoverlap.
design_decision.independent_joel_stratum: Use separately frozen natural-owner Joel originals from an independent source/platform as a second stratum, reported separately because platform/register transfer is a confound.
design_decision.aggregation_rule: Do not average matched-Dharma and independent-Joel strata into one score.

forbidden_claims: Joel has enough fully nonoverlap Dharma material for the intended four-author design
Stian's automated acquisition failure means he is unusable as a hard negative
the current source freeze proves a stable Joel-Stian neighborhood
a target-centric design is numerically equivalent to closed-set IER
